name: validation-evidence-blob-buffer-limit
title: Remove the one-mebibyte execFileSync limit that makes validation evidence unpersistable
description: isolatedBlobHash reads staged blobs with execFileSync and no maxBuffer, so any story whose test-evidence.json exceeds Node's 1 MiB default cannot persist validation evidence and can never pass the REVIEW to TEST gate. Adds an explicit maxBuffer to every blob and tree read in the module, replaces the silent catch that disguises the buffer overflow as a digest mismatch, adds a regression above the limit, and evaluates bounding the artifact itself.
